summary: SeaStar Medical filed an 8-K disclosing October 2, 2026 letter agreements with holders of 854,002 prior common stock purchase warrants, inducing cash exercise at a reduced $3.866 per share. Holders received new Series A warrants (854,002 shares, five-year term) and Series B warrants (854,002 shares, 18-month term), both immediately exercisable at $3.616, with resale registration required within 30 days of signing and effectiveness targeted within 60-90 days. The transaction resembles a warrant-inducement financing. Watch dilution from up to 1.708 million new warrant shares and potential selling pressure upon resale registration effectiveness.
